# V1.2 — Bug fixes

**Status:** Done, all 6 items committed on `main`. Reported/grilled 2026-06-26 (`/grill-with-docs`).

New ADRs from this grill: **ADR-0015** (sync liveness), **ADR-0016** (display name).

Build order was: **4 → 1 → 3 → 2 → 6 → 5** (cheapest/most-isolated first; 5 last as the architectural slice). Items 1 & 3 both touch notes; 6 & 5 are the big ones.

| # | What | Commit | Locked design |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Share button on new notes** | `7ffd547` | Removed the `!state.isNew &&` guard in `NoteEditorScreen` so the heart shows while writing (only gated by `isPaired`). `toggleShared()` toggles local `isShared` for new notes without a remote call (no-op until the note exists). `save()` calls `shareNote(id, coupleId)` after `upsertNote()` when creating a new note with `isShared = true`. Known edge case, accepted as-is: a blank new note with the heart on still hits the existing `isBlank && isNew → Unit` discard path, silently dropping both the note and the share intent. |
| 2 | **Calendar: 2 rows (income + expense)** | `7ffd547` | 2 rows per cell: `+₱X` green (income), `-₱X` red (expense). Zero rows show only the nonzero row, vertically centered. Today cell keeps green/error-red (not forced `onPrimaryContainer`) — the highlight background alone signals "today". Cell height bumped 52→~64dp. Compact formatting: ones `+₱4`, tens `+₱45`, hundreds `+₱162`, 1k–9k `+₱1.58k` (2dp), 10k–999k `+₱88.8k`/`+₱888.1k` (1dp), millions `+₱1.88M` (2dp). `DailyNetData` exposes `incomeByDay`/`expenseByDay`; `CalendarDayUi` replaces `netFloat` with `incomeFloat`/`expenseFloat`. |
| 3 | **Partner shared notes not appearing** | `7ffd547` | `NoteDao.observeNotes()` fixed → `WHERE (userId = :userId OR isShared = 1) AND isDeleted = 0`. `NoteEntity.toDomain(currentUserId)` computes `isPartnerNote = userId != currentUserId`. `NoteListItem` gains `isPartnerNote`/`partnerName`; `NotesViewModel` `flatMapLatest`-combines notes + partner name. `NoteCard` shows "From {name}" for partner notes, hides delete menu. `NoteEditorScreen`: read-only title+editor, heart/add-image hidden, attachment strip without delete buttons for partner notes; `save()`/`toggleShared()`/`addImage()` guarded. 4 new mapper tests. |
| 4 | **Donut chart order** | `d170a52` | Moved the donut above the Expense Flow card in Analysis MONTH view — pure composable reorder, no domain/data changes. |
| 5 | **Sync too slow / not live** | `7ffd547` | **ADR-0015, Opus.** Two independent fixes; partner data flows through redacting views (ADR-0005), so naive `postgres_changes` is rejected (RLS/leak). **(A) Own writes:** `SyncEngine.pushOnly()` (push half, FK order); a repo-write signal triggers it debounced ~1.5–2s (push-all-dirty, FK parent-before-child). **(B) Partner live:** Realtime **Broadcast** as a content-less "bell" — private channel `couple:{coupleId}`, RLS policy on `realtime.messages` keyed to `auth_couple_id()`. After a push that sent rows, broadcast a ping (no row data → no redaction bypass). Partner runs new `SyncEngine.pullOnly()` (debounced ~1s, mutex-coalesced). `receiveOwnBroadcasts=false`; pulls write `pending_sync=false` → no ping-pong. `@Singleton CoupleChannelManager` combines foreground × pairing state → subscribe only when foregrounded+paired; WorkManager stays the background safety net. New dep `realtime-kt` + `install(Realtime)`. Sync loop itself left sequential — slowness was triggering, not the 15-table walk. |
| 6 | **User display name (couples identity)** | `7ffd547` | **ADR-0016.** Schema `users.display_name` already existed; nothing wrote it. **Capture:** required name field at registration (trimmed, non-blank, ≤50 — `AuthCredentials.validateName()`); `signUp` passes `data = { display_name }` into `signUpWith(Email)`. **Seed:** `EnsureCurrentUserRowUseCase` reads name via `CurrentUserProvider.displayName()` (`session.user.userMetadata["display_name"]`) — respects ADR-0013 (no DB trigger). **Edit:** new Settings → Profile submodule → `ProfileScreen` (editable name via `UpdateDisplayNameUseCase`, accent color reusing V1.1's `ColorPickerDialog`, read-only email). **Fallback:** null name → "Partner"/"You", never email (defensive sync-timing only). Unblocks item 3's partner-name marker. |

`7ffd547` bundles items 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 together (interleaved shared files, one commit). Item 4 was isolated (`d170a52`). 329 JVM tests pass; `assembleDebug` green.
